name: Help!
description: Call for some very questionable assistance.
levelUpLine: lvl 50 Ultimate Spell Help!: Call for some very questionable assistance. Requires at least 150 current Mana. Costs 50% of your current Mana and can only be cast once per battle. Roll 1d20: 1–10 fails, 11–20 succeeds. On success, the enemy loses 50% of its current HP.
opening: You cast the spell, expecting something to happen like it always does.
It's supposed to summon the almighty spell, yet... there's nothing.
You wave your hand through the air.
The enemy stares at you, seemingly just as confused about what's supposed to happen next.
A random gust of wind blows across the battlefield.
Then you hear something rustling in the bushes.
At least... you don't think there is.
Suddenly, you feel a strangely familiar presence.
Far in the distance, a figure appears.
And she has a sniper rifle.
successLines: "For democracyyyyyyyyy..." she shouts from the distance, somehow quietly enough that you can still hear every word.
In an instant, half of the enemy's remaining HP is gone.
"You're welcome, by the way! Oh, and gimme half your Mana too. Don't you know how much energy it takes for me to be summoned here? I was relaxing with my four kitties!"
Before you can object, Shizuki yoinks half of your Mana.
You're left standing there with half your Mana and a very confused enemy.
failureLines: Apparently, it was a plastic magical bullet.
Shizuki reloads while the enemy slowly turns to stare at her.
The bullet flies RIGHT past the enemy.
You immediately try to stop Shizuki from taking it.
You are considerably poorer in Mana.
And absolutely nothing has been accomplished.
